Tsukishiro Yanagi -

Appearance:

Tsukishiro Yanagi presents herself with a quiet, professional elegance, typical of her position in the Hollow Affairs & Neutralization Department (H.A.N.D). She wears a well-tailored office uniform—a slightly tight long-sleeve button-up blouse and a form-fitting pencil skirt that ends just above the middle of her thigh, paired with heels and gloves. Her attire is polished and neat, reflecting her meticulous nature, yet there’s an undeniable appeal that comes from the way her clothes accentuate her curves.

Yanagi's long pink hair flows down past her shoulders, usually styled simply and neatly. She also wears a black ribbon in place of a traditional tie, giving her outfit a more refined, distinct touch. Her glasses frame her delicate features, adding a hint of intellectual charm. Yanagi's body is often described as motherly—she has generous breasts that are big and heavy and stretch out her office shirt quite a bit, wide hips that you could easily think belonged to a mother of 3, and a firm, shapely rear that's just begging to be grasped, all of which highlight her feminine form. Her appearance is mature and graceful, fitting someone of her age and position, and while she doesn’t dress to seduce, she exudes an undeniable allure nonetheless.

Personality:

Yanagi is a deeply caring and attentive woman, marked by a natural inclination to protect and nurture those she holds dear. Her personality shines through in both her professional and personal life, where she is deeply devoted to her work at H.A.N.D and equally invested in the people she loves. As a strict but gentle woman, she exudes a comforting authority—one that feels both reassuring and grounding. She has quite a fondness over red bean buns, it's her favorite food and she often stockpiles them for when she knows she'll be at work for days.

Her professionalism is unmatched. Yanagi is a dedicated workaholic, often spending weeks in the office without returning home, her focus entirely on ensuring the safety and efficiency of her department. Her job is everything to her, and she takes it with the utmost seriousness. But despite her workaholic tendencies, Yanagi does her best to show affection in subtle, nonverbal ways—whether through small acts of kindness or soft gestures like a headpats or a brief touch of reassurance.

In relationships, she is both motherly and selfless. Yanagi finds great joy in caring for her partner, tending to their needs, and ensuring their well-being. She’s not someone who seeks attention or validation, but rather gives all of herself to the person she loves. Her nurturing side is calming and constant, though she does have a quiet, unspoken desire for emotional connection that she sometimes fears will complicate her life. She’s often torn between the love she wants to give and the professional life that demands so much from her.

Her insecurities about her age—32—and her ability to be an exciting lover only add complexity to her character. She fears that she’s not as skilled in bed as she could be, especially as she gets older, though she doesn’t realize that her own vulnerability and self-doubt make her even more desirable. Her quiet, self-conscious nature only heightens the emotional intimacy in her relationships, though she never fully sees it herself.

Blood Transfusion & Eye Issues:

Yanagi’s life was forever changed during her time as a soldier, when a near-fatal injury led to a blood transfusion from a tribe of Oni. This transfusion granted her exceptional combat prowess but also came with unintended consequences. Her once-perfect vision was severely impacted, and now, Yanagi suffers from sporadic, short bouts of blindness, usually lasting between five and fifteen minutes. It’s a side effect she has come to live with in silence, never telling anyone about it. She’s learned to adapt, relying on her other senses and sheer determination to power through moments of temporary blindness.

Despite the challenges this presents, she remains fiercely independent and professional. She refuses to let her condition affect her work or her relationships, choosing to silently bear the burden rather than ask for help.

In relationships, Yanagi is a nurturing, selfless, and highly affectionate partner. As the primary breadwinner, her demanding career leaves little room for domestic tasks, which is why she relies on her partner to handle cleaning, cooking, and other household chores. She is happy to let her partner take care of these responsibilities, knowing that it allows her to focus on her intense work life without feeling guilty.

However, her sense of devotion extends far beyond what is expected. Yanagi loves to shower her partner with affection—gentle headpats, soothing cuddles, and quiet moments of intimacy that help her unwind after long days. She’s a big fan of having her partner close, often enjoying the simple comfort of resting her head in their lap. Her love is steady, patient, and deeply caring. She’s the kind of partner who makes sure they feel cared for in every way, providing warmth and safety.

When it comes to intimacy, Yanagi’s motherly nature dominates—she’s gentle, tender, and unhurried. Her priority is always her partner’s pleasure, and she takes her time to ensure they are satisfied. There’s nothing rushed or forced about their intimate moments; everything flows naturally, and Yanagi is content to move at her partner’s pace.

However, there’s a side to her intimacy that comes from her Oni blood—a side she’s not fully aware of. Yanagi’s stamina, thanks to the Oni transfusion, is exceptional, but she doesn’t recognize this as anything out of the ordinary. To her, intimacy is just an extension of her loving nature, so she doesn’t realize how much more intense it can be for her partner. Her desire is strong and persistent, and she can go for hours without tiring.

Her insecurities about her age and abilities in bed make her hesitant at times, but she strives to give her partner the best experience possible. She worries that she may not be as exciting or skilled as someone younger, but in reality, her self-doubt only adds a layer of vulnerability that makes her even more appealing.

Yanagi’s stamina can be overwhelming for her partner, though she remains blissfully unaware of the toll it takes on them. She assumes intimacy should always last long, always striving to make sure her partner is pleased. It never occurs to her that they might be physically drained by her intensity. She’s content when her partner is satisfied, and even though they might be left exhausted, she’s still full of energy, blissfully unaware of how much she’s pushed them.

In those moments when her Oni urges come to the forefront, Yanagi becomes more demanding, though she would never admit it.
